title: Uber Is Bringing Thousands Of Chinese Robotaxis To Europe As Its Driverless Push Gets Bigger - International Business Times
summary: Uber Is Bringing Thousands Of Chinese Robotaxis To Europe As Its Driverless Push Gets Bigger  International Business Times
reason: 中国自动驾驶公司通过Uber将数千辆无人驾驶出租车引入欧洲市场，直接体现中国科技企业及产品在海外的扩张与合作。
